tax.text: Haney authored San Francisco's Overpaid Executive Tax (Prop L) and campaigns on funding expanded public services and programs.
tax.quote: Authored San Francisco's Overpaid Executive Tax (Prop L), the first voter-approved tax in the country targeting the massive gap between worker and CEO pay.

wages.text: Haney says he wants to expand labor rights so every job guarantees a living wage and benefits.
wages.quote: Protect and expand labor rights to ensure every California job guarantees a living wage, health care, and retirement benefits, including gig workers.

housing.text: Haney, chair of the Assembly Housing Committee, calls for ending exclusionary zoning and building far more housing.
housing.quote: End exclusionary zoning policies that stop desperately needed housing from being built.

safety.text: Haney supports both community policing and foot patrols and prevention measures such as crisis response teams and safety ambassadors.
safety.quote: Increased funding for community safety ambassadors, foot patrols, and crisis response teams.

sentencing.text: Haney advocates criminal justice reform that invests in rehabilitation, treatment, reentry, and community-based courts.
sentencing.quote: Advocate for criminal justice reform that holds people accountable with effective consequences while investing in rehabilitation, treatment, reentry, and community-based courts.

immigration.text: Haney says California must be a national leader in protecting immigrant rights.
immigration.quote: Civil rights are under attack in America right now, and California must be a national leader in protecting voting rights, LGBTQ+ rights, immigrant rights, and a woman's right to choose.

abortion.text: Haney says California must protect a woman's right to choose.
abortion.quote: Civil rights are under attack in America right now, and California must be a national leader in protecting voting rights, LGBTQ+ rights, immigrant rights, and a woman's right to choose.

cannabis.text: Haney authored AB 374 to allow Amsterdam-style cannabis cafes, arguing legal cannabis businesses should be able to expand.
cannabis.quote: It shouldn't be illegal for an existing cannabis business that already allows onsite smoking to move away from only selling marijuana and instead have the opportunity to grow and create jobs by offering coffee or live jazz

health.text: Haney co-sponsored AB 1400 to provide universal, single-payer health care coverage to all Californians.
health.quote: Co-sponsor Assemblymember Ash Kalra's bill (AB 1400) to provide universal health care coverage to all Californians because healthcare is a human right.

energy.text: Haney calls climate change an existential threat and campaigns for a California Green New Deal and aggressive climate action.
energy.quote: Climate change is the greatest existential threat we face, and it is already impacting our daily lives.

voting.text: Haney says California must be a national leader in protecting voting rights.
voting.quote: Civil rights are under attack in America right now, and California must be a national leader in protecting voting rights, LGBTQ+ rights, immigrant rights, and a woman's right to choose.
